core-fixes/checkpoint-stale-lock.reason: A checkpoint git killed past its timeout left a store index lock behind and every later checkpoint of that workspace failed; clear a stale lock inside the store (older than 600 s) and retry once (fork 565d63a2ee3).

core-fixes/cron-external-interpreter.reason: Cron script jobs on an external Nix install run on that install's own interpreter instead of a missing store venv (fork f52195c165d, P26).

core-fixes/deferred-tool-hint-scope.reason: Remember the agent of the running tool round in a ContextVar so the unknown-name error can tell which deferred tools are reachable through tool_call (fork 5e94a2c2fd1, P16).

core-fixes/deferred-tool-hint-text.reason: A call to a deferred tool by its own name is told to use tool_call instead of the does-not-exist error (fork 5e94a2c2fd1, P16).

core-fixes/edit-diff-host-backend.reason: The inline edit diff shows for a host plugin backend that declares is_remote=False, such as nono (fork e6f7bfe0989, P12).

core-fixes/edit-diff-text-patch.reason: The inline edit diff shows for a patch whose result is plain text, diffed from the before-snapshot (fork e6f7bfe0989, P12).

core-fixes/patch-mode-targets.reason: A patch call with mode patch and no V4A body targets its path instead of an empty parallel-write scope (fork fd118ea2512, P14).

core-fixes/sandbox-deferred-tools.reason: execute_code hermes_tools offers the deferred tools the session can reach through tool_call, so from hermes_tools import web_extract works (fork a2ac9e421c8, P9).

core-fixes/tmux-notify-passthrough.reason: OSC 9 and Warp OSC 777 desktop notifications are dropped by tmux; DCS-wrap the sequence when TMUX is set so they reach the outer terminal (fork 38836268730, P47).

lane-mirror/forward-list-titled.reason: An admin's /resume <id> --all lists titled sessions without the platform filter, so the mirror can bind a machine-local session (lane forward)

lane-mirror/forward-submit.reason: An un-attached prompt.submit to a session a Discord thread owns is relayed into the thread as the mirror admin instead of refused (lane forward)

lane-mirror/gates-attach.reason: A file dropped in the TUI on a lane-bound session is staged in the folder the session recorded, under its viewer policy (lane takeover, gates)

lane-mirror/gates-local-source.reason: The subscribed operator's own client may run a shell command in a lane-bound session: the local-source gate is open for that one call (lane takeover, gates)

lane-mirror/gates-mutate.reason: Compress, rewind, reset and branch never commit on a session a Discord thread writes: lane_owned, the TUI relays the typed command (lane takeover, gates)

lane-mirror/gates-shell.reason: A !cmd typed in the TUI on a lane-bound session runs in the folder the session recorded, for the subscribed operator only (lane takeover, gates)

lane-mirror/gates-side.reason: /bg and /btw on a lane-bound session are lane_owned: the thread runs the side agent, never a second writer here (lane takeover, gates)

lane-mirror/model-adopt-rehydrate.reason: A local conversation a messaging lane took over adopts the route it ran as the lane chat's /model pick, once (lane model carry)

lane-mirror/model-resolve-reasoning.reason: A lane chat's effort is its own durable pick, else the level its local session ran, before the profile default (lane model carry; 20-line copy)

lane-mirror/model-retire.reason: Deleting a session also deletes its hand-off route record, in the same connection (lane model carry)

lane-mirror/model-route-info.reason: A handed-off local chat shows the route it keeps in the model and effort pills (lane model carry)

lane-mirror/model-set-reasoning.reason: A typed /reasoning or a viewer's effort pick replaces the carried level and is persisted for the lane so it survives a restart (lane model carry)

lane-mirror/repaint-goal.reason: A /goal command run in a Discord thread bound to a TUI session repaints the viewer's goal and loop bars (lane viewer repaint)

lane-mirror/repaint-handler-table.reason: A slash command run in a Discord thread bound to a TUI session republishes the viewer's session.info pills and the command output (lane viewer repaint)

lane-mirror/repaint-heartbeat.reason: A /heartbeat command run in a Discord thread bound to a TUI session repaints the viewer's goal and loop bars (lane viewer repaint)

lane-mirror/repaint-loop.reason: A /loop command run in a Discord thread bound to a TUI session repaints the viewer's goal and loop bars (lane viewer repaint)

lane-mirror/repaint-refine.reason: A /refine command run in a Discord thread bound to a TUI session repaints the viewer's goal and loop bars (lane viewer repaint)

lane-mirror/repaint-review.reason: A /review command run in a Discord thread bound to a TUI session repaints the viewer's goal and loop bars (lane viewer repaint)

lane-mirror/repaint-subgoal.reason: A /subgoal command run in a Discord thread bound to a TUI session repaints the viewer's goal and loop bars (lane viewer repaint)

lane-mirror/rescue-policy.reason: A non-LOCAL source has no launch policy except while a read of a lane-bound session is re-run under its viewer policy (lane takeover, rescue)

lane-mirror/settle-register.reason: An approval answered anywhere (a platform card tap, /approve in the thread, a timeout) is withdrawn from every attached viewer at once (approval settle)
